# FreeQrly

> FreeQrly is a free QR code generator: static codes need no sign-up, no tracking, no expiry.
> Static codes are generated locally — on this website in your browser, or via the
> API/MCP below for agents. Dynamic codes need a free sign-in, so they can be edited after printing.

## For AI agents

FreeQrly is agent-native. You can generate QR codes without a browser:

- **MCP server:** `https://freeqrly.com/mcp` (Streamable HTTP)
  - Tool: `generate_qr` — no auth. Params: `data` (required, max 2000 chars),
    `size` (128–2048, default 1024), `color` / `bgcolor` (6-digit hex), `ecc`
    (L/M/Q/H, default M). Returns a ready-to-download SVG URL.
  - Authenticated tools (pass `Authorization: Bearer <api_token>` header;
    create the token in the dashboard under API Tokens): `dynamic_qr_create`
    (`type`, `payload`), `dynamic_qr_list`, `dynamic_qr_update`
    (`code`, `type`, `payload`), `dynamic_qr_delete` (`code`),
    `dynamic_qr_stats` (`code`). Same editable dynamic codes and quota
    (8 free) as the dashboard UI.
- **HTTP API:** `GET https://freeqrly.com/api/qr?data=TEXT&size=1024&margin=4&color=2F4A62&bgcolor=ffffff&ecc=M`
  - Returns `image/svg+xml`. Free, no key, CORS open. `data` is required.
  - Dynamic codes (Bearer `<api_token>`): `POST /api/codes`
    (`type`, `payload`), `GET /api/me/codes` (list + quota),
    `GET /api/codes/{code}/stats`, `PATCH /api/codes/{code}`,
    `DELETE /api/codes/{code}`.
- **Skill:** see `skills/qr-generator/SKILL.md` in https://github.com/BryceBin/freeqrly
- **Docs:** https://freeqrly.com/developers/

QR payload formats the generator understands:
- URL: `https://example.com`
- WiFi: `WIFI:T:WPA;S:NetworkName;P:password;;`
- vCard: `BEGIN:VCARD\nVERSION:3.0\nN:Name\nTEL:+123\nEMAIL:a@b.c\nEND:VCARD`
- Geo: `geo:37.7749,-122.4194`
- SMS: `sms:+123?body=hello` · Phone: `tel:+123` · Email: `mailto:a@b.c`

## Site map

- `/` — the studio (17 QR types incl. Batch mode, logo upload, PNG/SVG export, transparent background option, local history, 10 languages)
- `/scan/` — free QR scanner (camera + image upload, decoded 100% on-device with jsQR, nothing uploaded)
- `/barcode-generator/` — free barcode generator (Code 128, EAN-13, UPC-A, Code 39, ITF-14, rendered 100% on-device with JsBarcode, PNG/SVG download, nothing uploaded)
- `/google-form-qr-code/` — QR codes for Google Forms
- `/wifi-qr-code/` — WiFi QR codes
- `/vcard-qr-code/` — vCard contact QR codes
- `/batch-qr-code/` — bulk QR generation with ZIP download
- `/business-card-qr-code/` — QR codes for business cards
- `/google-review-qr-code/` — Google review QR codes
- `/qr-code-with-logo/` — QR codes with your logo in the center
- `/wedding-qr-code/` — wedding QR codes (RSVP, photos, seating)
- `/instagram-qr-code/` — Instagram profile QR codes
- `/real-estate-qr-code/` — real estate listing QR codes
- `/blog/` — field notes: all guides
- `/blog/how-to-scan-a-qr-code/` — how to scan a QR code (iPhone & Android)
- `/blog/why-is-my-qr-code-not-working/` — troubleshooting unscannable codes
- `/blog/qr-code-print-size-guide/` — print sizes and the 1:10 rule
- `/blog/qr-codes-for-restaurants/` — menus, reviews, WiFi for restaurants
- `/blog/free-qr-codes-that-dont-expire/` — static codes that never expire
- `/blog/scan-qr-code-online/` — scan QR codes online (no app, no upload)
- `/blog/scan-qr-code-from-image/` — decode QR codes from pictures
- `/blog/qr-codes-for-events/` — events: check-in, calendar, photos
- `/blog/wedding-rsvp-qr-code/` — wedding RSVP QR guide
- `/blog/do-qr-codes-expire/` — do QR codes expire?
- `/blog/static-vs-dynamic-qr-codes/` — static vs dynamic explained
- `/about/` — what FreeQrly is (Organization facts)
- `/developers/` — API & MCP documentation
- `/sitemap.xml` — all pages

## Brand

- Mascot: Qly, a small periwinkle-blue elephant, hosted at https://assets.freeqrly.com/mascots/v1/<pose>.webp (512x512 webp, transparent). 12 poses: home-welcome, studio-qr, scanner, batch, privacy, success, faq, error, wifi, business-card, wedding, logo-customize.
- Tone: quiet, direct, a little dry. No hype, no "AI slop".

## Languages

FreeQrly speaks 10 languages: English (/), 中文 (/zh/), Español (/es/), हिन्दी (/hi/),
العربية (/ar/), Português (/pt/), Français (/fr/), Русский (/ru/), Deutsch (/de/), 日本語 (/ja/).
Each has a fully translated static homepage for SEO. The studio UI translates client-side
via ?lang= parameter (e.g. /wifi-qr-code/?lang=es).
